page_title: VAL 1-0 LEV | Valencia v Levante 21/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Matias Moreno (Levante) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
90+9' Hugo Duro (Valencia) receives a yellow card.
90+9' The match has just finished.
90+9' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
90+9' That's a clear yellow card. Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) goes into the book.
90+5' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) sends a nice lofted cross into the box from the free kick, but his effort is plucked out of the air by Julen Agirrezabala.
90+5' Diego Lopez (Valencia) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! There is a free kick near the sideline to Levante.
90+3' Kervin Arriaga (Levante) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Alejandro Ruiz saw the whole situation.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
89' Jose Morales (Levante) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dani Raba (Valencia) replaces Andre Almeida.
85' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Thierry Correia (Valencia) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Dimitri Foulquier.
85' It is time for a substitution. Baptiste Santamaria (Valencia) is on for Javi Guerra.
84' Julian Calero has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) replacing Unai Elgezabal Udondo.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jose Morales (Levante) will replace Unai Vencedor.

83' Goduine Koyalipou (Levante) connects with a cross from the side and steers a header from around the penalty spot towards the goal. The ball goes in the right direction, but it's stopped by one of the defenders.
81' Jose Gaya (Valencia) goes into the book and receives a yellow card.
80' The attendance is 46302.
79' 1 - 0 What a goal that is! Jose Gaya sends a brilliant cross into the box and Hugo Duro (Valencia) scores a stunning bicycle kick goal! Wow, take a bow gentlemen. 1:0.
78' Luis Rioja (Valencia) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
77' Andre Almeida (Valencia) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
76' Andre Almeida (Valencia) swings it in and Hugo Duro gets on the end of it, but Mathew Ryan shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
74' The current number of shots on goal is 2:0.
73' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Arnaut Danjuma walks off the pitch to be replaced by Luis Rioja (Valencia).

72' Hugo Duro (Valencia) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball low to the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
72' The ball is out of play. Valencia will have a chance to score from a corner.
70' That will be all from Etta Eyong who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Goduine Koyalipou (Levante).
70' Here is a change. Oriol Rey is going off and Julian Calero gives the last tactical orders to Kervin Arriaga (Levante).

68' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Valencia.

65' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Valencia players aren’t happy.
63' Goal! The rebound fell to Diego Lopez (Valencia) and he fired home from close range. The score is 1:0.
63' It will be a corner kick for Valencia.
63' The linesman points to the corner flag, Valencia are going to take it. Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
61' A cross from Andre Almeida (Valencia) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
60' Some great controlled play and passing from Valencia. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
57' Unai Elgezabal Udondo (Levante) makes a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.
54' The substitution is prepared. Hugo Duro (Valencia) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lucas Beltran.
53' Valencia have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
49' Thierry Correia (Valencia) gets a yellow card.

47' Pepelu (Valencia) is furious with himself. He is quickest to the rebound near the penalty spot, but his header goes well over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Jose Copete (Valencia) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Javi Guerra (Valencia) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
40' Andre Almeida (Valencia) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
40' A dangerous looking corner kick from Andre Almeida (Valencia) is cleared to safety by the defence.
39' The ball goes out of play. Valencia are awarded a corner kick.
35' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Levante.
34' Oriol Rey (Levante) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
31' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) receives a yellow card.
30' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that crashes into the defensive wall. The opposition's goalkeeper set it up perfectly.

29' Pepelu (Valencia) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Alejandro Ruiz with no other option than to blow for a foul. Levante earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
28' A cross from the by-line finds Etta Eyong (Levante) unmarked on the penalty spot, but he is unable to find the target and sends his header well wide of the left post.
28' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
27' Thierry Correia (Valencia) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for an infringement. Levante have a free kick from a promising distance.
26' Lucas Beltran (Valencia) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Levante are awarded a free kick.
21' Alejandro Ruiz interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Cesar Tarrega (Valencia). Levante are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
20' Oriol Rey (Levante) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
19' Unai Vencedor (Levante) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
15' Diego Lopez (Valencia) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
14' Lucas Beltran (Valencia) is flagged for offside.
12' Mathew Ryan pulls off a great save to deny Lucas Beltran (Valencia), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.

8' Oriol Rey (Levante) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
5' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) sends a cross into the box, but Julen Agirrezabala comes off his line to gather the ball.
4' Valencia keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
2' Jose Gaya (Valencia) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
